Hannah L.: Weekly dedicated-capacity check for Catalyst — quick snapshot.

- GPU hours (7d): 3,200h (-7% WoW)
- Saturation: peak 92% between 10:00–12:00 PST
- Queue depth: avg 12, p95 18, max 24
- p95 inference latency: 420ms (baseline 350ms)

Can we get short actions: @Samir P. can you confirm autoscaler behavior and whether we can temp-bump pool during peak? @Marta G. any scheduled heavy jobs? :eyes:

Hannah

Samir P.: saw the spike — autoscaler didn't add nodes because one scheduler pod was CrashLooping last Wed. I restarted the pod at ~11:12 and we recovered, but the transient caused queues to pile.
I'll:
- Investigate crash root cause
- Do a temporary pool bump for Catalyst today (adding 2 GPUs to reserved pool)
Command I'll run: ```redwoodctl capacity adjust --tenant catalyst --add-gpus 2 --reason "peak bump"```
ETA: done by 14:00 PST

Samir

infra-bot: [Alert] pool-catalyst-saturation triggered 1850130015 — saturation >90% for 20m
- nodes: 12/13 full
- avg queue: 14

infra-bot

Marta G. (Catalyst): we did queue a nightly training rerun Tue->Wed and moved some eval traffic to prod by mistake. Sorry — can shift heavy jobs to 2–4am PDT going forward. Appreciate the bump. Also watching spend — let us know projected GPU-hours delta.

Marta

Priya K.: noted renewal check: if saturation continues 2 weeks in a row we should flag for renewal risk and propose reserved increase. @Hannah can you add to account deck? Also capture customer ask for schedule controls.

Priya

Samir P.: bump executed at 13:45 PST, verified queue depth down to avg 6 within 20m. Still following up on pod crash logs. I'll post logs snippet if I find root cause.

Samir
